title: Retire the caller budget section from the effect.activate payload contract
description:
OBJECTIVE: close the migration window and make a caller-supplied budget section UNREPRESENTABLE on effect.activate. LINK 4 OF 4, the endpoint of the fence-narrowing chain, and the row that finally discharges task-e194c5f6's "caller BudgetAvailableView/balances/coverage become unrepresentable or explicitly refused" clause in its strongest form.

Small by construction, because links 1-3 did the spreading. Drop "budget" from EFFECT_ACTIVATE_PAYLOAD_KEYS (apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ingress-contracts.ts:32), remove link 1's temporary two-shape tolerance so the count-then-membership fence is exact again at five sections, and delete the comment that named this row as the one that would do it. A payload still carrying the key is then refused BY THE FENCE with its existing exact code and refusing layer — no new vocabulary, no new branch.

WHY THIS IS SAFE TO DO IN ONE SMALL ROW (the whole point of the chain): by the time this runs, zero senders send the section. Verify that before editing — do not trust this description. `grep -rn "budget:" $(grep -rln "liveClaims" apps/daemon/src tests --include=*.ts)` must show no hit inside an effect.activate payload literal. If ANY sender still sends it, the migration is incomplete: report blocked naming the file, rather than landing a change that reds a foreign suite.

CHAIN CONTEXT, all filed by architect-eecf80ed alongside task-e194c5f6's plan: link 1 = task-8be276259b8043ec9ca6310ef9d1cb2e (relax the fence), link 2 = task-671585ec8ec4449795cb2e543ea9dcf9 (8 senders), link 3 = task-553b2165af4243c48fe2144d4f9ef5ed (8 senders). The 17-file measurement behind the split is recorded in task-e194c5f6's step 2.

NOT IN SCOPE: work.claim's own caller budget path, which is deliberately untouched by this entire chain, and any change to the derivation task-e194c5f6 landed.

HARD DEPENDENCIES: links 1, 2 and 3 all DONE.

A fresh sweep proves zero senders remain: the grep in the description returns no effect.activate payload literal carrying a budget key, and the sweep's own case count is asserted positive so a silently-empty sweep cannot pass.

A mutation drill that re-adds "budget" to the roster reddens the unrepresentability assertion, and a drill that removes a different section reddens its own arm; both named in the completion record.

`pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` and `pnpm test:security` each exit 0 with nonzero, at-or-above-baseline count lines quoted verbatim; repo-wide legs path-attributed and run from PowerShell.

  2. `activation/activation-ingress.ts:137` `budget: payload["budget"]` — PRODUCTION PASS-THROUGH, not a payload literal sent to the fence. See the seam measurement below; this line is the trap and it STAYS.

THE SEAM, measured before any edit, because the reopen reason and comment-86431a05 both say this is where the row dies:
  `activation-ingress.ts:136-141` builds its OWN five-key literal `{budget: payload["budget"], effect, lease, liveClaims: held, slot}` and hands it to `admitClaimPrefix`, which calls `readClaimSections` -> `mirror(payload, OUTER_KEYS, true)` (`work-claim.ts:38,:89`), and `mirror`'s exact clause is `if (exact && keys !== null && own.length !== keys.length) return null` (`work-claim-shape.ts:108`). OUTER_KEYS is five and INCLUDES "budget".
  **The literal always writes the key, so the arity stays 5 even when `payload["budget"]` is `undefined`** — `mirror` copies it via `("value" in descriptor)`, which is true for an explicit undefined. So dropping "budget" from `EFFECT_ACTIVATE_PAYLOAD_KEYS` does NOT collapse the arity; DELETING line 137 would. I am not deleting it, and the completion record will say so with this measurement rather than leaving the next reader to rediscover it.
  Also confirmed inert on this route: `admitClaimPrefix` (`work-claim.ts:193-208`) reads `sections.lease`, `sections.liveClaims`, `sections.slot` — never `sections.budget`. The live budget read `claimBudget(prefix.value.sections.budget)` belongs to work.claim's own route and is out of scope.

  `EFFECT_ACTIVATE_PAYLOAD_KEYS` (`activation-ingress-contracts.ts:32-39`) = six sorted keys including "budget".
  `TOLERATED_PAYLOAD_SHAPES` (`:178-181`) = the sorted roster and the roster minus "budget"; `isSectionRecord` (`:193-197`) accepts sorted strict equality against EITHER.
  The tolerance comment at `:166-177` names THIS row: "REMOVED BY task-b8b69e74".
